items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: We used to play all the jobs that he couldn't take.

ctx.x: You know, the white folks used to have them picking, I don't know, no, I don't think you're old enough to remember Millenburg, Camps. Hey, you're parked! No, I didn't remember Millenburg. Millenburg, West End, they used to have camps. And just about from here to that kitchen, that's just how for a camp, then. And boy, you're talking about, they used to have a Spanish fort, uh, stuff to that kitchen. That is how far the camp's been. And boy, you're talking about, you used to have a Spanish fourth call run out…
a good friend of your brother's. Yeah, that's right. We used to play all the jobs that he couldn't take.
He'd give it to us. That's how we worked together. He's still playing it, I think. Oh, sure. Yeah.
